llm_response.reason: Spritz Finance offers crypto-to-fiat and bill-pay services with relatively standard fees and without the hallmarks of scams such as unrealistic promises, urgent demands, or spoofing other brands. While the SSL certificate warning suggests exercising caution, there is no evidence of scam activity based on the content and domain analysis.
